title: CoCopula: Conformal Calibration and Copula Aggregation for Reliable Renewable Energy Forecasting
abstract: arXiv:2602.02583v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: The rapid growth of renewable energy penetration has intensified the need for reliable probabilistic forecasts to support grid operations at aggregated (fleet or system) levels. In practice, however, system operators often lack access to fleet-level probabilistic models and instead rely on site-level forecasts produced by heterogeneous third-party providers. Constructing coherent and calibrated fleet-level probabilistic forecasts from such inputs remains challenging due to complex cross-site dependencies and aggregation-induced miscalibration. Motivated by a real-world operational challenge identified through collaboration with an industry partner, this paper presents a probabilistic aggregation and calibration framework that directly converts site-level probabilistic forecasts into reliable fleet-level forecasts. translated_title: CoCopula：面向可靠可再生能源预测的保形校准与Copula聚合方法
translated_abstract: 可再生能源渗透率的快速增长加剧了对可靠概率预测的需求，以支持在聚合（车队或系统）层面的电网运行。然而在实践中，系统运营商往往无法获得车队级概率模型，而是依赖于由异构第三方供应商提供的站点级预测。由于复杂的跨站点依赖关系以及聚合所导致的校准失准，如何从此类输入构建连贯且校准良好的车队级概率预测仍然极具挑战性。受与行业合作伙伴合作中发现的实际运营挑战的启发，本文提出了一种概率聚合与校准框架，可直接将站点级概率预测转换为可靠的车队级预测。本文提出了CoCopula方法（保形校准与Copula聚合），该方法融合了基于Copula的……
tldr: 提出CoCopula框架，将保形校准与Copula聚合相结合，把第三方异构供应商提供的站点级概率预测直接转化为可靠且校准良好的车队级可再生能源概率预测。
en_tdlr: CoCopula integrates conformal calibration with copula aggregation to directly convert heterogeneous site-level probabilistic forecasts from third-party providers into reliable, well-calibrated fleet-level renewable energy forecasts.
